[Trait] JUPITER'S SON Opposing characters of less points than Hercules can't target Hercules except to make attacks.
[Trait] THE NEXT LABOR Powers: Willpower Willpower. // When Hercules starts the game, choose an opposing character. If that character is on the map, Hercules has "At the beginning of your turn, heal Hercules 1 click.". // When Hercules KOs the chosen character, score 25 Victory Points.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] BEAST OF LERNA Powers: Combat Reflexes, Close Combat Expert Lernaean Hydra starts the game with 5 heads and no empty necks on its sculpt. // Lernaean Hydra can have a maximum of 7 heads on its sculpt. // Lernaean Hydra can use the following effects based on the number of heads it has on its sculpt: 4+: SAFEGUARD: Outwit. 5+: Combat Reflexes. 6+: Close Combat Expert. 7: FREE: Make an attack.
[Trait] BEHEADING THE BEAST When Lernaean Hydra is dealt damage, you may remove up to two heads from its sculpt. If you do, reduce the damage taken by the number of heads removed in addition to any other effects.
[Trait] REGROWING HEADS Powers: Regeneration Regeneration as FREE. When Lernaean Hydra uses it, you may reduce the amount healed by any amount, to a minimum of 0. If you do, attach that many heads to any empty necks on Lernaean Hydra's sculpt.

[Trait] CALCULATED STRIKES At the beginning of your turn, Sherlock Holmes may roll 2d6 and note the result. If he does, the first attack roll he would make this turn uses the noted result instead of rolling. (That attack can't be rerolled or have its dice replaced.)
[Trait] THE GAME IS AFOOT! When Sherlock Holmes clears action tokens, you may replace him with a [set:wicn] #WKX-002 Sherlock Holmes on the same click number.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] DISGUISED TO FOOL SHERLOCK POWER: Generate 3 Adler Disguise bystanders and place Irene Adler on her card. At the beginning of your next turn, if Irene Adler is on her card, remove those bystanders from the game and place Irene Adler in a square one of them last occupied. // When Irene Adler generates Adler Disguise bystanders, exactly one must have "REAL" printed on its back.
